content:
Eleven fresh tracks are now in rotation on La Onda Libre, Tanya's free online indie radio station broadcasting from Laredo, Texas.

The new batch is led by five songs from Ketsa, the station's most-loved artist: "All Too Much," "Astek," "Minus 2," "Retake" and "Traction." Meydän adds two more with "L'Etoile danse" Parts 1 and 2.

Chris Zabriskie joins the station for the first time with "I Am a Man Who Will Fight for Your Honor" and "The Sun Is Scheduled to Come Out Tomorrow," and Kevin MacLeod rounds out the batch with two jazz tracks, "Groove Grove" and "Marty Gots a Plan."

La Onda Libre plays independent music around the clock, free for everyone. Listen live at webbwatch956.com.

Webb Watch 956

title: New Music on La Onda Libre: Ketsa, Chris Zabriskie, Meydän and Kevin MacLeod Join the Rotation
